models.title: Mystery · who has eaten the cake? (present perfect)

block.label: MYSTERY · WHO HAS EATEN THE CAKE?
block.html:
It's Grandma Rosa's 80th birthday. At 3 p.m., Mom put a big chocolate cake on the kitchen table. Now it's 4 p.m. Mom is back in the kitchen and... the cake has disappeared! There are only crumbs on the plate.

Uncle Beto: "I've just arrived! I haven't been in the kitchen yet. Look, my car is still in front of the house."

Cousin Lucas (12): "I haven't eaten anything since breakfast! I've been in the garden for two hours. I've played football all afternoon."

Aunt Carla: "I've already had a piece of cake today, at the bakery. I've been on the phone with my boss since three o'clock."

Max, the dog: "Woof!"

The clues
1. The engine of Uncle Beto's car is still hot.
2. It has rained all afternoon, but Lucas's sneakers are clean and dry.
3. Aunt Carla's phone: three calls since 3 p.m., all to her boss.
4. Max has slept on the sofa all afternoon. His mouth is clean.
5. There is chocolate on Lucas's T-shirt.

A made-up story.

lesson.title: Who Has Eaten the Cake? Present Perfect, Part 2
lesson.subtitle: Just · already · yet · result · for and since
lesson.plan: Feedback da aula 22: tacar o present perfect e juntar yet, already e os outros usos. 1) Warm-up (ever + superlativo) e speed round com 12 verbos novos. 2) Novos usos: novidade (just), already / yet, resultado agora; tabela de posição, prática e "o que aconteceu?". 3) Mistério do bolo: ler, perguntas de detetive, cada irmã acusa alguém com duas pistas, solução. 4) For / since e How long…? (com verbos de estado). 5) Chat, erros, jogos (liar liar, the most… ever), role-play e um minuto.
